messages:
nina.design: quick check  new compact latency row mock attached. Q: should sampling be an inline funnel icon beside the scrubber or only in the kebab menu? trying to balance discoverability + toolbar real estate. :sparkles:

ash.engineering: inline funnel seems more discoverable. implementationally it's a small click target that opens a tiny popover. caveat: in very narrow widths it shifts the scrubber; we can collapse time-range chips to icons at <640px.

mika.pm: from usability tests, people expect per-chart quick actions. they also get confused whether sampling affects p95 numbers. we need a concise help line: "Sampling affects visuals only; metrics stay full unless 'Lower metrics precision' is enabled."

zoe.a11y: prefer explicit wording. use exact switch label "Lower metrics precision" and add aria-describedby linking the switch to the help text. popover must have role=dialog, trap focus, and return focus on close. ensure funnel icon has aria-label="Open sampling options for Heatmap". also don’t use color alone to indicate state.

ash.engineering: backend note: dashboard-level sampling exists. per-chart persistence requires prefs schema change. we'll prototype UI with local state and gate per-chart save behind feature:per_chart_sampling. perf prototype shows ~22ms extra render when per-chart read is enabled.

nina.design: hybrid suggestion: keep global toggle in toolbar and show inline funnel for per-chart overrides (opens popover with On/Off, slider 5-100, breadcrumb "Applies to: Heatmap"). default: follows global. this keeps toolbar discoverable and stable.

mika.pm: telemetry checklist: sampling.open, sampling.toggled, sampling.rate_changed, sampling.scope (global|chart), sampling.help_opened. rollout behind flag to canary orgs.

zoe.a11y: slider aria: aria-valuemin="5" aria-valuemax="100" aria-valuenow, and aria-live="polite" for updates. ensure tap targets >=44px. color: propose p95 badge #a48ff8 on dark or 1px white outline.

nina.design: i'll update the spec with the short help copy, popover behavior, and a11y notes. posting updated mock: https://tiny.redwood/mini-funnel-v3. tagging notif-bot to create follow-up ticket. :white_check_mark:

notif-bot: created ticket #4522 "Hybrid sampling: funnel popover + toolbar toggle + a11y checklist" assigned to ash.engineering, due 2024-08-01.
